name: gmail-organizer
description: A powerful email organization tool for Gmail

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: npm run dev --prefix backend & npm run dev --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --prefix backend && npm run lint:fix --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.clean: rm -rf backend/node_modules frontend/node_modules node_modules && rm -rf backend/dist frontend/dist
